question: $5\frac{d^{2}x}{dt^{2}}$ + 180 x = 0 সমীকরণের কৌণিক কম্পাঙ্ক কত একক?
explanation:
$ 5 \frac{\mathrm{d}^2 x}{\mathrm{dt}^2}+180 \mathrm{x}=0 \text { বা, } \frac{\mathrm{d}^2 \mathrm{x}}{\mathrm{dt}^2}+36 \mathrm{x}=0 \text { এবং } \frac{\mathrm{d}^2 \mathrm{t}}{\mathrm{dt}^2}+\omega^2 \mathrm{x}=0 $ এর সাথে তুলনা করে।

$\therefore \omega^2=36$


বা, $\omega=6$

explanation:
এখানে,


$ \frac{\mathrm{L}_2-\mathrm{L}_1}{\Delta \mathrm{t}} =\frac{m v_2 r-m v_1 r}{\Delta t} $


$ =m r \cdot \frac{v_2-v_1}{\Delta t} $


$ =m r \cdot a=m \cdot r \cdot(r \alpha) $


$ =m r^2 \cdot \alpha $ [এখানে,$ \mathrm{I}=m r^2 ] $

explanation: $\begin{aligned} & v_{\max }=\omega A, x=\frac{A}{2} \text { হলে, } v=\omega \sqrt{A^2-x^2} \\ & \text { বা, } v=\omega \sqrt{A^2-\frac{A^2}{4}}=\omega \sqrt{\frac{3 A^2}{4}}=\frac{\omega \cdot \sqrt{3} A}{2}=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \omega A=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} v_{\text {max }}\end{aligned}$
